maximum_depth_rule: All 314 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until strategy, KPI, current, target, national, regional, provisional, and multi-year series can be mapped through reviewed table-level evidence.
evaluation_boundary: Targets and key performance indicators in the five strategy action plans remain separate from comprehensive-plan implementation reports, policy evaluation, project evaluation, and department-level results. Administrative project evaluation is not converted into a plan-indicator achievement rate.
series_boundary: Current values, target values, nationwide values, medical-area values, provisional values, and multiple reporting years remain separate until definitions, units, periods, and populations are reviewed.
non_goals: Do not fill the zero-row strategy four and strategy five documents by inference.
Do not convert project evaluation into plan-indicator achievement.
Do not merge current, target, national, regional, and provisional values automatically.
Do not infer actuals or targets from the large reference-material extraction.
Do not replace missing units or split multiple values by inference.
Do not calculate policy causality or cross-prefecture ranking.
